description: Use for "is any CFB ladder mispriced" and "where can I make a market on Kalshi". Kalshi college football and NFL spread/total strikes priced out of order: locked arbitrage, crossed-mid inversions and wide books worth making a market in, with both tickers and books, gross edge, volume and tier. Pro adds the resting orders, net-of-fee edge and quarter-Kelly size.

min_edge.description: Minimum NET edge in cents (default 1). Accepts 2, "2c", "2".

min_volume.description: Minimum per-leg volume in dollars (default 20000). Accepts 20000, "$20,000".
